corrections.critique: Strongest feature: Craig’s precisely staged descending schedule makes the contradiction vivid: survival beyond midnight is impossible, yet each Reaper is preempted by an earlier Reaper, so none can be the killer. Principal limitation: The construction depends on coordinated lethal conditionals, and Craig does not establish that ordinary beginningless succession shares this paradox-producing causal architecture rather than merely lacking a first member. Live burden: Craig must supply a transfer principle showing why contradiction attaches to successive infinity itself, while Malpass must explain how locally intelligible conditions coexist without an impossible global outcome in the stipulated schedule. Locked score: The strong/competent 82 reflects a logically forceful, centrally relevant answer whose concrete warrant succeeds within the example but whose broader scope remains implicit, overstated, and vulnerable to the restricted-structure reply.

Strongest feature: Malpass offers a modest countermodel in which a weak initiator produces stronger intermediaries, showing that the final effect’s magnitude alone does not entail equivalent power in the first cause. Principal limitation: The imaginative possibility blocks that entailment but provides little reason to regard mediated amplification as metaphysically available, and it does not answer Craig’s Grim Reaper contradiction despite the response linkage. Live burden: Craig must justify locating universe-producing power in the first member rather than across a causal chain, while Malpass must defend power-increasing mediation if discussion moves beyond defeating the magnitude inference. Locked score: The very strong 87 fits a precise, charitable, relevant diagnostic challenge whose calibrated possibility claim preserves a weaker alternative, although its evidential support remains thinner than its logical and burden-level effectiveness.
